texts.p_cards: Now tap a card to use your power!
texts.p_dodged: You hopped out of the way!
texts.p_find: Listen, and tap the word you hear.
texts.p_floor: You fixed every robot on this floor! The next floor is coming soon.
texts.p_gear_blue: You won a blue power suit! Now you are wearing it.
texts.p_gear_cape: You won a hero cape! Now you are wearing it.
texts.p_gear_helmet: You won a rocket helmet! Now you are wearing it.
texts.p_gear_laser: You won a laser blaster! Now you are wearing it.
texts.p_intro_o1: Welcome to the robot workshop! Here comes Dot-Bot! Read words to charge up your power.
texts.p_intro_o2: Welcome to the oil factory! Here comes Bob-Bot! He sprays oil, so here is a mop card to clean it up. This time, listen to the end of each word.
texts.p_intro_o3: Welcome to the junkyard! Here comes Tom-Bot! Now the start or the end can change. Look at every letter!
texts.p_intro_o4: Up on the rooftop at night... Uh oh! It's the big boss, Mop-Bot! Use everything you've learned!
texts.p_map: Tap the glowing robot to start!
texts.p_oil: Oil! Tap your mop card to clean it up.
texts.p_pick: Pick a new card for your deck.
texts.p_read: Read this word all by yourself, then tap its picture.
texts.p_stars1: You fixed it! Play again any time to win more stars.
texts.p_win: You did it! The robot is fixed, and now it's your friend!
